title: Exact integer isolation threshold and improved complete coefficient-four certificates

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. claims: For all integers k>r+1 and2<=t<r, with weights2,...,r+1 and integer dimensions0<=d_i<=k, H+E from proof.md Section1 and disperser.md Section11 is exactly the largest total dimension failing the positive t-subset isolation predicate sum_I(d_i-w_i)+max_I d_i>k+1. This is optimality only of that unchanged finite predicate, not of affine dispersers, actual circuits or other lower-bound methods.

The complete reference searches in proof.md Section6 are nonempty at every sufficiently large actual N. The new selected loss is no larger than either reference whenever that reference exists. Exact (L_old,L_weighted,L_N) values are(1461,1437,1429) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577) at N=10000. These are certified-loss comparisons, not actual circuit-size comparisons.

experiments.purpose: Exact bounded integer-maximization against exhaustive dimension vectors and attaining witnesses, finite reference oracles, retained marked distributions, field-prefix and evaluator predicates. Finite checks do not prove universal circuit coverage or asymptotics.
